name: After § 77
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: 77a. Expresses deep concern over the agricultural aspects of the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement, highlighting the need for stronger protection for EU farmers in general, including robust mirror clauses for better alignment with EU environmental and social standards; asks, in these circumstances, for the EU-Mercosur Agreement not to be ratified;
